answer: To deter Sybil attacks in an AI-agent economy covering trellis sensors, karst surveys, or vault backups, networks can require epoch-bound memory-hard Proof of Work. At each epoch, every agent must find a nonce satisfying an Argon2id target seeded by a shared beacon and its public key within a short deadline. Concurrent solving prevents reusing DRAM arrays across keys, forcing attackers to spend dedicated memory bandwidth and energy per identity, though wealthy actors can rent burst cloud RAM.
